prompt: What is the name of the in-place, stable comparison sorting algorithm with a worst-case time complexity of O(n log n) and a best-case time complexity of O(n)?
answer: The algorithm is **block sort** (also called **block merge sort**). It is a stable, in-place comparison sort with **O(n log n)** worst-case time and **O(n)** best-case time on already sorted input.
